title: Recreational Therapists

claims.text: Under Australia's ANZSCO classification, the US O*NET occupation 'Recreational Therapists' (29-1125) maps to ANZSCO 411311 Diversional Therapist, whose listed alternative title is 'Recreational Therapist'; the occupation sits in Unit Group 4113 Diversional Therapists and is classified Skill Level 3 (AQF Certificate III/IV).

sources.title: ANZSCO - Unit Group 4113 Diversional Therapists; Occupation 411311 Diversional Therapist (alt title Recreational Therapist)
sources.whatItMeasured: ABS ANZSCO First Edition Rev 1 classification of the AU equivalent occupation; retrieved 2026-08-30

claims.scope: Classification of the Australian equivalent occupation; sets skill level and title, not the registration regime.
claims.refuteNotes: Source real (ABS ANZSCO); measures the AU-equivalent occupation, in window.

claims.text: Recreational/Diversional Therapists are NOT among the 16 health professions regulated by AHPRA under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law; AHPRA's register covers medicine, nursing, midwifery, psychology, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, pharmacy and others but not diversional or recreational therapy, so the occupation is not subject to National-Law registration or protected-title provisions.

sources.title: Registers of practitioners - listed regulated professions

claims.scope: Establishes absence of National-Law (AHPRA) regulation for the occupation; does not preclude state/employer or professional-association registration.
claims.refuteNotes: Source real (AHPRA); the 16 listed professions exclude diversional/recreational therapy.

claims.text: The ANZSCO 2024 consultation draft reclassifies the occupation as 411331 Diversional Therapist at Skill Level 2 (AQF Associate Degree/Advanced Diploma/Diploma or 3+ years relevant experience), separating it from Lifestyle Coordinator (411332); the draft was released 25 July 2024 and remains a consultation draft, not yet operative.

sources.title: Consultation draft ANZSCO July 2024 - Occupation 411331 Diversional Therapist

claims.scope: Consultation draft only; not the operative classification. Supersedes the 411311 grouping once enacted.
claims.refuteNotes: Source real (ABS draft); draft status noted.

claims.text: The professional body for the occupation is Diversional and Recreation Therapy Australia (DRTA, formerly Diversional Therapy Australia); NSW Health (HETI) states that to be a member as a Diversional Therapist requires a Bachelor of Health Science (Recreation Therapy) or equivalent, indicating voluntary professional-association rather than statutory registration.
